# PCA

The following results come from the analysis of 39698 SNPs, on different loci,
selected among 190266 ddRAD loci, where at least 60 (out of 90) individuals
have a coverage depth of at least 2.

### Arctic region (ARCTIC)

```{r plotPCAs, fig.height=8, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, collapse=TRUE}
library(ape)
library(plyr)
library(ggplot2)
bams <- scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE)
Labels <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1', bams)
Lake <- factor(substring(Labels, 1, 1), levels = c('L', 'S'), ordered = TRUE)
Lake <- revalue(Lake, c("L"="Langfjordvatn", "S"="Suohpatjávri"))

#Region <- factor(rep('Alpine', length(Lake)), levels = c('Arctic', 'Alpine'))
#Region[Lake %in% c('Langfjordvatn','Suohpatjávri')] <- 'Arctic'
cov <- as.matrix(read.table('PCangsd/ARCTIC.cov'))
e   <- eigen(cov)
tab <- as.data.frame(e$vectors)

#lake_color = c("yellow2", "royalblue", "orange1", "darkorange3", "seagreen4", "pink2")
ggplot(tab, aes(x = V1, y = V2, col = Lake)) + geom_point(size = 8) + 
  labs(x = paste("PC1", round(100 * e$values[1] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%"), 
       y = paste("PC2", round(100 * e$values[2] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%")) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), 
                     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 20)) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("yellow2", "royalblue"))
  #geom_text(label = rownames(tab), nudge_x = 0.25, nudge_y = 0.25, check_overlap = F)
```

```{r}
ggplot(tab, aes(x = V1, y = V3, col = Lake)) + geom_point(size = 8) + 
  labs(x = paste("PC1", round(100 * e$values[1] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%"), 
       y = paste("PC3", round(100 * e$values[3] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%")) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), 
                     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12)) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("yellow2", "royalblue"))

ggplot(tab, aes(x = V2, y = V3, col = Lake)) + geom_point(size = 8) + 
  labs(x = paste("PC2", round(100 * e$values[2] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%"), 
       y = paste("PC3", round(100 * e$values[3] / sum(e$values), digits = 2), "%")) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), 
                     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12)) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("yellow2", "royalblue"))

```

# NGSadmix
Perform Admixture analysis on `angsd` results. 
Ordered by lake, and not by proportions. 

```{r NGSadmixPlots, collapse=TRUE, figure.align = "center", fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
source('/data/joiglu/bin/evalAdmix/visFuns.R')
MetaData <- read.table('../../data/IDs/Crepido_fish_IDs_all_data_2021Dec.txt', header = TRUE)
row.names(MetaData) <- MetaData$P_code
IndNames <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1',
                 scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE))
Lake <- MetaData[IndNames, 'Lake']
Lake <- revalue(Lake, c("Langfjordvatn"="LAN", "Suopatjavri"="SUO"))
Q <-  read.table(paste('NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K2.qopt', sep=""))
ord <- orderInds(pop = Lake, q = Q, popord = c('LAN', 'SUO'))

source('../../bin/plotAdmix.R')
for (i in 2:3) {
  Q <-  read.table(paste('NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K', i ,'.qopt', sep=""))
  par(mar=c(7,4,4,2))
  plotAdmix(Q, pop = Lake, ord = ord, rotatelab = 180, 
            colorpal= c("yellow2", "royalblue", "red4"),
                      main = NULL,
                      cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 2 ,padj = 0, cex.inds = 1,
                      drawindslines = TRUE)
}

```

Saving the results:
```{r SAVE_NGSadmixPlots, eval = FALSE, collapse=TRUE}
source('/data/joiglu/bin/evalAdmix/visFuns.R')
MetaData <- read.table('../../data/IDs/Crepido_fish_IDs_all_data_2021Dec.txt', header = TRUE)
row.names(MetaData) <- MetaData$P_code
IndNames <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1',
                 scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE))
Lake <- MetaData[IndNames, 'Lake']
Lake <- revalue(Lake, c("Langfjordvatn"="LAN", "Suopatjavri"="SUO"))
Q <-  read.table(paste('NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K2.qopt', sep=""))
ord <- orderInds(pop = Lake, q = Q, popord = c('LAN', 'SUO'))

source('../../bin/plotAdmix.R')
if (!dir.exists('PLOTS')) {dir.create('PLOTS')}

Q2 <-  read.table(paste('NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K2.qopt', sep=""))
tiff(filename = paste('PLOTS/ADMIX_ARCTIC.K2.tiff', sep=""), width = 4200, height = 1200, units = "px", res = 300)
#par(mar=c(8,4,4,3))
plotAdmix(Q2, pop = Lake, ord = ord, rotatelab = 180, 
          colorpal= c("yellow2", "royalblue"),
                    main = NULL, cex.lab = 2, padj = 0.1, cex.inds = 0,
                    drawindslines = TRUE)
dev.off()

Q3 <-  read.table(paste('NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K3.qopt', sep=""))
tiff(filename = paste('PLOTS/ADMIX_ARCTIC.K3.tiff', sep=""), width = 4200, height = 1200, units = "px", res = 300)
#par(mar=c(8,4,4,3))
plotAdmix(Q3, pop = Lake, ord = ord, rotatelab = 180, 
          colorpal= c("yellow2", "royalblue", "red4"),
                    main = NULL, cex.lab = 2, padj = 0.1, cex.inds = 0,
                    drawindslines = TRUE)
dev.off()



```

# IBS by sampling only one read per site per individual (alternative to fineRADstructure)

### Arctic region (ARCTIC)

```{r PCA_MDS, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, collapse=TRUE}
Labels <- scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE)
Labels <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1', Labels)
m1 <- as.matrix(read.table('Likes2/ARCTIC.ibsMat'))
row.names(m1) <- Labels
colnames(m1)  <- Labels
heatmap(m1, scale = 'none', Colv = 'Rowv', symm = TRUE, cexRow = 0.5, cexCol = 0.5)


```

Saving the results:

```{r SAVE_HEATMAP, eval=FALSE, collapse=TRUE}
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
Labels <- scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE)
Labels <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1', Labels)
m1 <- as.matrix(read.table('Likes2/ARCTIC.ibsMat'))
row.names(m1) <- Labels
colnames(m1)  <- Labels
tiff(filename = "PLOTS/HEATMAP_ARCTIC.tiff", width = 3000, height = 3000, units = "px", res = 500)
pheatmap(m1, color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"))(12), 
         treeheight_row = 0,
         fontsize = 10, 
         border_color = NA,
         legend = TRUE,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         cellwidth = 2.5, cellheight = 2.5,
         )

dev.off()

Labels <- scan('ARCTIC.list', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE)
Labels <- gsub('^.*/(.*)\\.bam$', '\\1', Labels)
m1 <- as.matrix(read.table('Likes2/ARCTIC.ibsMat'))
#row.names(m1) <- Labels
#colnames(m1)  <- Labels
Lake <- substring(Labels, 1, 1)
paleta <- c(B = 'darkgreen', L = 'yellow', N = 'orange', S = 'blue', T = 'brown', W = 'pink')
heatmap(m1, symm = TRUE, revC = TRUE, labRow = '', labCol = '',
        RowSideColors = paleta[Lake], ColSideColors = paleta[Lake])
png('PLOTS/HEATMAP_ARTIC_SYM.png', width = 3000, height = 3000, units = 'px', res = 500)
heatmap(m1, symm = TRUE, revC = TRUE, labRow = '', labCol = '',
        RowSideColors = paleta[Lake], ColSideColors = paleta[Lake], 
        col = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"))(12))
#legend(x="left", legend=c("min", "med", "max"), fill= colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"))(12))

dev.off()
```
